messages:
jordan: Customer acme-corp reports streaming session "abruptly ends" after an empty chunk. They get 200 OK, then a few seconds of no data, then client-side connection RST. No resume token in the last event, so their SDK can't resume. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/t/12345. X-Request-ID: req-7f3c1b9a

jordan: Repro snippet they used:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\\"https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams/generate\\\" \\\"-d '{\"model\":\"open-xxl\",\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'\\\" --no-buffer
```

noah-support: Can you paste the raw bytes they received (first 2KB) or at least the last SSE event? do we have edge logs for req-7f3c1b9a? :eyes:

jordan: Raw tail we got from customer (sanitized):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
transfer-encoding: chunked

data: {"id":"evt-abc","delta":"Here's the partial output..."}

data: 



# connection idle for ~3s then client RST
```

maria-sre: Please collect: tcpdump on edge02 (eth0), proxy logs for the request (nginx/access + upstream), and LB connection metrics for the 13:10-13:12 UTC window. Also check proxy upstream read_timeout / keepalive settings. I want to confirm whether upstream closed first or edge did.

olivia: Runtime side: I see a tail-latency spike around 2024-11-06T13:11:10Z for that model group, but no OOMs. The model server returned 200 and then the stream's body ended; upstream stack shows an upstream close without an explicit error. Need kernel-level FIN/RST traces to see who sent RST.

zach: Auth rotation note: we had a KMS key rotation event around 13:08 in prod-keys. If customer SDK attempted resume with a token signed before rotation, they might get a 401 on reconnect. Can someone check auth-middleware logs for req-7f3c1b9a and any resume-attempt 401s?

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished 2024-11-06T13:05:02Z on svc-proxy (rev 2024.11.06-7).

noah-support: Customer is on SDK 1.3.7 — there was a resume handling fix in 1.4.2 that changed the reconnect backoff and token refresh. Two immediate asks for the customer: 1) upgrade to 1.4.2 (or run a quick repro with the curl command to isolate SDK behavior), 2) enable client debug logs and capture tcpdump (we should capture TLS handshake + packets to see FIN/RST). I'll draft a message template.

jordan: Also saw an unexpected billing spike aligned with the spike window — billing ingestion shows token count jump for the customer's org at 13:11. Not sure if duplicate retries created extra tokens. Adding billing snapshot to ticket.

maria-sre: I'll pull the pcap from edge02 and the proxy access logs and post a short summary. If the upstream sent FIN then we need to look at model server logs for that timeframe; if edge sent RST, likely proxy limit or keepalive issue.

olivia: I'm dumping traces for req-7f3c1b9a now (xray span attached to the ticket). If I see an upstream HTTP/2 GOAWAY or stream reset from the model process I'll flag it.

zach: Checked auth logs briefly: one reconnect attempt at 13:12 from the customer resulted in 401 for resume-token 'rt-9x7' — looks like token validation failure. We'll correlate with key rotation events.

noah-support: Proposed repro steps to send to customer:
- Upgrade SDK to 1.4.2 (or use curl --no-buffer as above)
- Reproduce the streaming call 3x back-to-back and capture client-side debug logs
- Run tcpdump on client and ask us for edge pcap (we'll provide timeframe)
- If it's resumable, attempt reconnect using same socket vs fresh socket and note HTTP response codes

jordan: Ok. Plan: maria will fetch pcap + proxy logs, olivia will attach runtime traces, zach will validate auth rotation timing, noah will send the customer repro template and SDK upgrade request. I'll reply to customer by 18:00 UTC with checklist. Priority: high. :white_check_mark:

maria-sre: pcap request queued with infra, pulling now (ETA 30m).

olivia: uploaded traces to ticket and linked span id xray:span:7f3c1b9a.

noah-support: Drafted customer message and sending after we confirm pcap pulled.

jordan: thanks everyone, adding follow-up remind for EOD.
